rule_name: HR viewer read-only access
description: hr_viewer can only read HR data.
validator_message: hr_viewer cannot execute HR write tools.
llm_prompt_instruction: Generate only read-only HR steps for hr_viewer.
healing_guidance: Route write request to hr_manager or admin.

rule_name: HR manager approval authority
description: hr_manager can approve HR workflows and maintain HR workflow evidence.
validator_message: HR approval role must be hr_manager or admin.
llm_prompt_instruction: Use HR approval tools only for hr_manager or admin.
healing_guidance: Request HR manager approval.

rule_name: Employee identifier required
description: employee_id is required for employee lookup, role validation, cost center, travel eligibility, and active status checks.
validator_message: employee_id is required for HR lookup.
llm_prompt_instruction: Ask for employee_id when HR lookup is needed.
healing_guidance: Request missing employee_id.

rule_name: Inactive employee workflow block
description: Inactive employees cannot submit travel or reimbursement workflows.
validator_message: Inactive employee cannot initiate travel or reimbursement workflow.
llm_prompt_instruction: Validate active employee status before travel or reimbursement.
healing_guidance: Stop workflow and escalate to HR.

rule_name: HR modification authority
description: Only HR manager or admin can modify HR data.
validator_message: Only HR manager or admin can modify HR data.
llm_prompt_instruction: Do not generate HR mutation steps for non-HR managers.
healing_guidance: Request HR manager approval or create capability request.

rule_name: Limit employee personal data in LLM prompt
description: Employee personal data must not be included in LLM prompts except ID, role, and department when needed.
validator_message: Sensitive employee data cannot be exposed to LLM prompt.
llm_prompt_instruction: Use minimal HR fields only.
healing_guidance: Redact sensitive fields before prompt grounding.

rule_name: HR approval reads require audit
description: HR read operations used in approval workflows must be audit logged.
validator_message: HR lookup used in approval workflow requires audit log.
llm_prompt_instruction: Add audit log when HR data grounds approvals.
healing_guidance: Append audit.write_audit_log.
